learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.

prediction.reason: Clear plausible extrapolation choices and locked commitment.

interaction.reason: Four contrasts expose growing water share and retain two boundary results.

payoff.reason: Explicitly resolves wrong prediction using observed numbers and25°C limit.

clarity.reason: Controls understandable; advanced notation and inner scroll burden general learner.

transfer.reason: Dilution limit reusable but stated specifically for strong acid and25°C.

practicalValue.reason: Concrete acid dilution context without applied task.

depth.reason: Dilution, water contribution and equilibrium limit linked.

complexity.reason: Core requires relating dilution and water contribution as a limiting floor; notation adds substantial prerequisite demand.
complexity.conceptualDemand: Linked acid/water contributions and neutral limit; pH logarithmic representation and ion-product explanation unfamiliar under common boundary.
complexity.interfaceBurden: Four clearly labeled controls; powers, ions and internal scrolling add burden.

whyCool: A further tenfold dilution changes pH from6.98to7.00 while the water bar dominates the remaining acid.
caveat: Reveal introduces pH/log scale and ion-product notation without demonstrating these prerequisites; no independent factual validation.
missingEvidence: Keyboard/focus, phone, zoom/reflow, contrast and motion untested.
